newsitem.title: UK: Brent dates brought forward by equity holder.
newsitem.headline: Brent dates brought forward by equity holder.

text.p: The loading date of a Brent cargo originally scheduled to come down the paper chains on Thursday has been brought forward by two days at the request of equity holders BP, traders said.

No Brent dates were due down the paper chains on Tuesday under the original Brent loading programme for October. The Oct 25-27 date was brought forward and was still doing the paper rounds on Tuesday afternoon.
Traders could not say why an earlier loading date had been requested but a trader for a U.K. major said it could be linked to storage problems at the North Sea terminal at Sullom Voe.
"We get the impression that they want us to lift early," another equity holder said.
The last Brent deals were on Monday, when two cargoes traded at Nov +10 cents. A Brent seller said offers were coming in single digits on Tuesday afternoon but no new deals were heard.
